items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And from Harry “Sweets” Edison, “Our ambition in my day not to be an imitator but an originator...”

ctx.x: I want to read — I know there’s a discussion that happens about original sound etcetera. I want to read two very short quotes from — this is the generation before you and I. This is from Billy Mitchell. He said “There’s a lot of youngsters get caught up in the proficiency and the musicality and they forget the emotion. The emotion takes longer. You have to experience it.” And from Harry “Sweets” Edison, “Our ambition in my day not to be an imitator but an originator, and they used to say they’d rather be the…
I agree with both of those things but in one — the first one was Billy Taylor you said?
